categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and directly alters peer address sampling in src/addrman.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a severe statistical bias in addrman bucket sampling that skews peer connection selection. The PR description shows that sequentially scanning from a random slot causes extreme distribution skews (e.g., '95.3% versus 4.7% in a two-entry bucket'), directly undermining uniform peer selection and eclipse resistance.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: The tests added in src/test/addrman_tests.cpp and src/test/fuzz/addrman.cpp specifically test addrman sampling behavior rather than test framework machinery.
categories.rationale: Tests specific to an area belong to that area rather than test infrastructure.
